text:
Oliver Hayes: Heads-up: were shipping two billing policy changes next month: 1) invoice line-item consolidation by model-family (instead of by route) and 2) a short-term credit rollover pilot for eligible customers. This is a billing reporting/UX change, not a price increase. :loudspeaker:

Oliver Hayes: Rationale: customers told us mapping spend to model choice (gpt-*-style variants) matters more than route-level granularity. Also some teams asked for a small rollover so unused promotional credits aren't lost during slow months.

Dana Li: TL;DR:
- Invoice change: token/embedding consumption will be grouped on invoices by model_family (e.g., redwood-giant-embedding) with per-model token totals and unit rates. Well keep the route label on the Console for debugging, but invoices will be consolidated to reduce noise.
- Credit rollover pilot: eligible accounts (annual contracts and select mid-market customers) can rollover up to 30 days of unused free/promotional credits each billing cycle, capped at 20% of their monthly allocation.
- Rate-limit cushion: were replacing the minute-grace window with a small hourly cushion for new accounts; existing accounts keep their current grace window for 60 days.

Arman Kaur: Rollout plan:
- Week 0: feature flag + invoice preview for all customers behind a toggle. Customers can opt into "preview invoices" from Console -> Billing.
- Week 2: enable model-family consolidation for hosted invoices; preview mode for 7 days before defaulting.
- Week 4: start credit rollover pilot for selected accounts (opt-in).

Zoe Park: Support playbook (short answers):
- "Why does my invoice look different?" -> We now group spend by model family to make cost-per-model clearer.
- "Did my rates change?" -> No. Unit prices and totals won't change, just grouping on the invoice.
- "Can I opt out?" -> Yes, there's an opt-out toggle in Console -> Billing during the 7-day preview.
- "How do I join the rollover pilot?" -> Sales or Support can add eligible accounts; rollout is opt-in.

Oliver Hayes: Finance note: invoices will include a new metadata field line_item.grouping = "model_family" and a migration line item called "lineitem_consolidation_note" for the first cycle to help reconciliation. No retroactive charges.

billing-bot: Automated: feature_flag billing.model_family_consolidation created, owner=@dana, toggled=off, audit_id=bb-2455012345.

Dana Li: API snippet to preview your next invoice grouping: 

```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY" \n  "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/billing/invoices/preview?group_by=model_family"
```

Arman Kaur: Compliance/legal: rollover credits are promotional value only and do not change tax treatment. Legal will sign off on customer-facing terms before pilot launch.

Zoe Park: Action items:
- @dana: enable the invoice preview endpoint + Console card (ETA 48h)
- @arman: draft customer-facing terms for rollover pilot with Legal (ETA 72h)
- @support: build KB with screenshots and canned responses (ETA 48h)
- @finance: expect a new invoice metadata field and migration note line item (ETA 48h)

Oliver Hayes: Special note for partners/resellers: we'll provide a passthrough flag so partners can keep route-level granularity on partner invoices. Partners will get a separate rollout email.

billing-bot: Automated: migration_job queued job_id=job-2455012350 type=invoice_preview_calc est_time=12h.

Dana Li: Telemetry requests: billing.invoices.preview_requested, billing.lineitem_consolidation.applied_pct, billing.rollover.opt_in_count. Eng-infra please add.

Zoe Park: Support escalation: if customers report reconciliation issues during the first billing cycle, tag with label billing_recon_2025Q2 and escalate to Billing Eng and Finance.

Arman Kaur: Confirming Private/Dedicated customers are unaffected unless they opt in; we will ship a toggle for appliance deployments.

Oliver Hayes: We'll post a short public FAQ and an in-console explainer next week. If you have major objections DM me ASAP. Closing thread for now.
